name: Put Type 1 Code
definition: Defines the type of execution of the put feature.

MAND.name: Mandatory
MAND.definition: Type of execution of the put feature is mandatory.

OPTI.name: Optional
OPTI.definition: Type of execution of the put feature is optional.

TWOS.name: Both
TWOS.definition: Type of execution of the put feature could be optional or mandatory.
